**Chinese name:** 深圳中环领先半导体材料有限公司 (Shēnzhèn Zhōnghuán Lǐngxiān Bàndǎotǐ Cáiliào Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
TCL Zhonghuan (TCL中环) is primarily a solar (photovoltaic) silicon wafer company — the world's largest by shipment volume (190GW capacity, 125.8GW shipped in 2024) — and is tracked here specifically for its separate, smaller semiconductor-grade wafer business, not its core solar operation, to avoid overstating its role in the chip supply chain. That semiconductor-materials segment grew 17% year-on-year even as the parent company's core solar business posted a net loss (narrowing, but still a loss) amid a broader Chinese solar-panel oversupply downturn — a useful reminder that a company's overall financial headlines can mask a growing chip-adjacent sub-business.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Large-diameter semiconductor-grade silicon wafers, via a dedicated new project — the 'Integrated Circuit Semiconductor Large Silicon Wafer Shenzhen Project,' through subsidiary Shenzhen Zhonghuan Lingxian Semiconductor Materials Co., Ltd. — with a planned total investment of approximately ¥11.96 billion. A separate Ningxia Zhonghuan facility has also been recognized as a national-level 'intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory,' though this tracker could not confirm a capacity breakdown specific to semiconductor-grade (as opposed to solar) wafers there.
